title: RC AFK Rewards
body:
# RC AFK Rewards
### Lightweight AFK Plate Reward Plugin

## 📋 Overview

**AFK Rewards** is a simple and lightweight plugin that rewards players when they stand on a designated **AFK plate**.

Perfect for **AFK farms, reward zones, hubs, and spawn areas**.  
Players earn rewards simply by being online and present — increasing overall server activity and engagement.

---

## ✨ Features

- Gives coins at configurable time intervals  
- Works via **Vault** (supports any Vault-compatible economy)  
- Full **DecentHolograms** support  
- GUI menu for easy AFK plate setup  
- Simple and clean configuration  
- Very low server performance impact  
- Customizable messages and holograms  

---

## ⚙️ Requirements

- **Vault** (required)  
- Any economy plugin (EssentialsX, CMI, etc.)  
- **DecentHolograms** (required for hologram display)  

---

## 🎮 Commands

```text
/afkrew gui     - Open AFK plate setup GUI (OP by default)
/afkrew reload  - Reload plugin configuration (OP by default)
```

---

## 🔐 Permissions

```text
afkrewards.use   - Allows players to receive AFK rewards
afkrewards.admin - Full access to plugin features
```
